memo_delta.summary: HCG has declined approximately 6.8% since the June 1 Avoid call while NIFTY 50 rose approximately 3.3% and NIFTY Healthcare rose approximately 2.9%, giving the Avoid a roughly 10-percentage-point relative benefit vs benchmark at 40 days. A potential fourth CFO change (Sanjeev Kumar replacing interim CFO Mattoo, effective May 25, 2026) may have occurred at or after the analysis pool cutoff and, if confirmed as new, deepens the governance concern per kill criterion 7. All major thesis catalysts -- the FY26 audited annual report and the Q1 FY27 results (~July 30, 2026) -- remain pending and unresolved.
memo_delta.stage_one_comment: HCG is down roughly 6.8% since the June 1 Avoid call versus a roughly 3.3% rise in NIFTY 50, giving the Avoid an approximate 10-point relative benefit in 40 days. The thesis is on-track but not yet confirmed: no upgrade kill criteria have triggered and the biggest test, the FY26 audited annual report, is still pending and overdue vs the expected June-August 2026 window. A potential fourth CFO change (Sanjeev Kumar replacing Mattoo if post-pool cutoff) would deepen the governance concern but does not change the rating -- the Avoid was already supported by 7 High governance flags. Q1 FY27 results are due around July 30 against a demanding revenue bar of approximately plus 20% versus a plus 11.5% exit rate; a miss would further validate the Avoid thesis. We maintain the Avoid at approximately INR 602, with the next major catalysts the FY26 audited AR and the Q1 FY27 print. Re-underwrite threshold remains INR 520 or two consecutive clean prints showing ROIC rising toward the cost of capital.
